title: Embedded model selector and inline request composer — visual asset set for onboarding flow
creator: Amaya Patel
description: Deliver a distinct set of high-fidelity PNG/JPEG assets and annotated mockups for the Hosted API onboarding flow that show a compact model selector embedded in the request composer, inline parameter presets, and code-snippet toggles across three languages. This set is intended for the docs site, in-app quickstart carousel, and the onboarding email. Goals: 1) Reduce friction when users pick a model from the inline flow, 2) Demonstrate how to build a request in the composer and switch to code snippets, 3) Surface cost & latency hints in the UI mockups.
scope: Design assets for: embedded model picker modal, request composer panel (collapsed/expanded), parameter presets menu, code snippet drawer (JS / Python / curl), streaming indicator state, token estimator overlay, model variant badge, and small-screen adaptations (mobile portrait). Exports at 2x and 3x for retina assets. Include annotated spec sheet for engineers with spacing and color tokens.
acceptance_criteria: All screenshots exported at @2x and @3x, filenames using kebab-case with component and state
Accessible alt text provided in screenshot notes for each image
Includes both light and dark theme variants for each primary screen
Engineers have an annotated spec (PNG + CSV of spacing/colors) and a Figma link
PM approval received on copy and param presets
QA checklist created for visual regression tests in docs pipeline
